nom: Saturday Skin Yuzu Vitamin C Brightening Sleep Mask

segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin are split: several report itchiness, pinkness/stinging, or caution when combining retinol and glycolic acid, while others with sensitive or even mild rosacea skin report zero irritation and good hydration.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including one describing 'the world's driest skin,' report the mask relieves tightness and dehydration without triggering breakouts.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin consistently report brighter, more balanced-looking skin, hydration in dry patches, and no increase in oiliness or clogged pores in the T-zone.
segments.mature: A reviewer in her mid-30s dealing with fine lines alongside mild acne, and others noting wrinkle-minimizing and plumping effects, describe smoother, more supple skin after use.

concerns.aging: Reviewers report smoother fine lines, plumper skin, and a more youthful look after regular use; one mid-30s reviewer with fine lines and mild acne says it works well for both concerns at once.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority describe relief from dryness, tightness, and dullness, waking up with soft, plump, hydrated skin, including reviewers in cold climates or with very dry skin; no reviewer reports the mask worsening dryness.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports the mask cleared sunburn-related redness and scaly winter skin, though this is a single account with no dissenting reports.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer states the mask helped rebuild the skin barrier overnight, while sensitive-skin reviewers elsewhere report stinging or itchiness suggesting some sensitivity to its actives (retinol, glycolic acid).
concerns.spots: Several reviewers report dark spots and hyperpigmentation fading or lightening with continued use, including one who compares it favorably to a dedicated dark-spot serum; effects are described as gradual.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers, including some prone to breakouts or with acne-prone/combination skin, report no new breakouts or clogged pores; one reviewer with sensitive skin experienced stinging and pinkness rather than blemishes specifically.
concerns.oiliness: Combination-skin reviewers specifically note the mask does not increase oiliness in the T-zone and balances skin without a greasy finish.

aspects.libelle: Jar size misleading versus product amount
Long-lasting due to small amount needed

extraits.titre: It's nice, but not for my sensitive skin
extraits.texte: I love the cheerful yellow packaging and how versatile this product is, working as a night cream, mask, or sleeping mask. Ive only used it as a sleeping mask so far, and my skin felt incredibly smooth and soft the next morning. That being said, it was a bit strong for my sensitive skin. I woke up in the middle of the night with some itchiness around my nose, which I suspect was due to the combination of retinol and glycolic acid. My skin may need time to adjust, but for now, I see myself using it once a week or at most every two weeks because of this. Gifted by Saturday Skin

It smells so nice but be careful if you have sensitive skin. Made my skin slightly pink and stung a little. I gave it to my mom and she loves it though. She says it makes her very moisturized and brightens her skin

This mask is wonderful. Overnight my dark spots are noticeably lightening much more quickly than just my kiehls dark spot serum. My skin tone overall is more even. Fine lines on my forehead are visibly smoother. My skin has been more sensitive this past year but I've had no problem using this mask several times a week. I recommend easing up to that amount of use gradually. This tub will last you a while. It only takes one scoop that comes with to cover my entire face. I did break the plastic that separates the scoop and lid from the product inside but it hasn't been too much of an issue.

extraits.titre: Smells and feels great on my skin!
extraits.texte: The Saturday Skin Yuzu Vitiamin C Sleep Mask helped my combination skin look brighter and feel more balanced. The first thing I noticed was the crisp virus scent, which I loved. The texture of this mask is lightweight and gellike, with small soft bits of yuzu that melt into my skin as soon as you apply it. It feels cooling and hydrating and doesn't leave any sticky residue. After using it overnight, my skin felt refreshed, smoother, and more balanced. The dry patches looked more hydrated, and my overall complexion had a healthy glow. It didnt clog my pores or make my oily areas worse, which is a huge plus for combination skin. I would definitely purchase this sleep mask again because it smells great and feels great on my skin. Complimentary from saturdayskin

This overnight mask gifted by Saturday Skin is really unique in that it has an interesting texture with flecks in it that somehow absorb overnight while the product goes to work to moisturize and brighten the skin. I have combination skin with mild rosacea, and experienced zero issues with using this product. It felt really nice and slightly cooling on my skin upon application. It absorbed easily and left my skin feeling and looking both refreshed and balanced in the morning.

I have the worlds driest skin after I had my daughter 6 years ago and I haven't found anything that acts makes my skin feel so soft without making me break out really bad. I've only used for 2 nights now but typically if I use something in my skin by morning I'm broken out or it doesn't work and I have to put moisturizer on 34 times a days. And with this I don't have to. I absolutely love it

I got this in my ipsy box and now I have to reorder it. Im in my mid30s in a time where I have the pleasure of mild acne and fine lines at the same time. This product is perfect for my combination skin! When I wake up my skin looks plumper, wellrested and so glowy. Love this stuff!
